{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the row with highest sample_seq
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Check that we now have one row per patient
print("Number of unique patient_id after deduplication:", df_dedup['patient_id'].nunique())
print("Total number of rows after deduplication:", len(df_dedup))

# Correct batch-B biomarker_final values: divide by 10 since batch-B reports in µg/L, not ng/mL
df_dedup['biomarker_final_corrected'] = df_dedup['biomarker_final']
df_dedup.loc[df_dedup['assay_batch'] == 'B', 'biomarker_final_corrected'] /= 10

# Compute the mean of corrected biomarker_final across all patients
mean_biomarker_final = df_dedup['biomarker_final_corrected'].mean()
print("Mean biomarker_final (corrected, in ng/mL):", mean_biomarker_final)"}
